name: Does cabinet removal include cleanup and disposal of old cabinetry?

mainEntity.name: Does cabinet removal include cleanup and disposal of old cabinetry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard cabinet removal handles disconnecting and taking down the cabinetry boxes and attached countertops, but hauling and disposal depend on the agreed scope of work. Many homeowners request full debris haul-away, where crews load old cabinets into a trailer or roll-off dumpster and sweep the area clean. If you plan to keep the units for workshop storage or donate them locally, crews will neatly stage the intact boxes in your garage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Full-service removal typically includes debris removal and sweep-up, or staging intact boxes in a garage if you choose to repurpose or donate them.
